I wasn't sure if I should trust a maid agency. Never used one in the past and I had heard really bad reviews for most of them. Mychores wasn't very responsive in the beginning either. I guess maybe they had too much happening.

But when they did start responding the experience was great! We would have never found a better nanny anywhere else. She speaks English. Manages our child and our home super efficiently and is a very positive happy person. She now lives with us 24/7. What I liked about mychores is the 5 day cooling period. I could try out the maid without having to pay anything significant. So the risk was low. And all the other candidates that I interviewed on video call were pretty decent too.

Overall I had a good experience with mychores and they have restored my faith in agencies. Have to be a little patient in the beginning but I'm glad we found someone good through them. Divya (the agent at mychores) was extremely helpful and very responsive with follow ups and feedback calls once the process took steam.

This was the first time we paid a brokerage cost to find a maid but I think it was totally worth it! Will recommend to others.
